summary: All 10 batch rows are clean, so the top status is pass. Control row K1 has one defect on its own: the line file shows no nose while the text is 'A nose.' and the goal names the nose. K2 and K3 are clean. All 13 counted line files are pure black and white, 0 pixels outside 0 and 255.

K1.notes: Character, pose, shirt star, eyes, brows, and mouth match the look and the color. Hand reads as a pointing hand. Pure black and white only (0 non-pure pixels).
K1.goal_check: Color: Nan touches her own nose with one finger and laughs - yes. Line: finger at the face, laugh mouth present, but the named nose does not show.
K1.line_check: 0 pixels outside 0 and 255. No gray or shading.

K2.notes: The profile line shows the nose tip clearly, with brow, eye (solid pupil, allowed), ear, mouth, and chin as closed shapes. The red hair ring around the bun shows in the color but not as a line in the line art; this changes no character, so it is a note. The bun reads as a bun. 'Facing the other way' is judged as facing right against the front-facing K1 pose; I could not compare with an earlier practice line.
K2.goal_check: Head of Nan in profile, nose clearly seen: yes in both files.
K2.line_check: 0 pixels outside 0 and 255. No gray or shading.
